definition: M3 canonical-first mathematical architecture, selectively reuse existing R1/R2 Study Contract, quantity, method/profile, governance, provenance and verification concepts and implementations. Not two authoritative mathematical normal forms.

decision_rule.primary: Meet all original requirements with minimum additional development, integration and maintenance complexity; avoid unnecessary duplication.
hard_constraints: No requirement removal or weakened original expectations
General study-independent, model-tool- and solver-independent external obligations
Full original A/B population and evidence boundaries preserved
Fail closed for unsupported or unproven semantics
No production or scientific approval inferred
decision_rule.basis: Observed scope, counterexamples and qualitative remaining work; no unmeasured cost or time savings claimed.

alternatives.M0: Frozen reference and fallback; not selected as primary because more mathematical language expansion required.
alternatives.M2: Not selected as general target; bounded legacy interoperability/migration only, retain genuine mapping and evidence; fix audit loss before using mapping for conformance.
alternatives.M3_greenfield: Not selected as rewrite of outer semantics: existing R1 features demonstrably valuable.
alternatives.M3_HYBRID: Selected, one mathematical canonical authority plus reuse of existing domain semantics and method validation.

authority_by_layer.mathematics: Pinned native mathspec Canonical Specification + public Program; no second authoritative mathematical AST
authority_by_layer.physical: Existing canonical_closure and R1 quantity algebra/registry; extend needed sign/basis/conversion context
authority_by_layer.contract: Reuse R1/R2 outer concepts and validated checks, adapt to native predicate signatures; C2 closes actual semantics
authority_by_layer.method: Reuse existing configurable MethodProfile/StudyProfile, R1/N2R/N7 weight/authority/exogeneity/ledger/result binding; mathematical rules reference native expressions; legacy evaluator may remain compatibility/oracle but not independent competing definition
authority_by_layer.canonical_outer: Versioned mathematical package plus outer contract semantics; separate audit; define semantic projection for description-only changes
authority_by_layer.migration: M0 frozen; M2 bounded and fail closed; no required generalized math-to-legacy translation
authority_by_layer.evidence: Original oracle population, distinct evidence scopes and receipts

decisive: RC03/04/05/06/08 native representation avoids legacy general math gaps
ABL09 old profile rejects invalid probabilities while M3 finite maths accepts consistent but inadmissible numbers
EXPOW old profile handles data-dependent integer powers, current M3 rejects
ABL06 legacy mapping loses audit source; legacy semantics can preserve it if mapped
ABL08 M3 semantic identity changes on documentation edits

reopen_conditions: Proven original requirement cannot be represented or validated in native+outer architecture without disproportionate extension
Unresolvable mathematical source/canonical semantic loss or upgrade risk
C4 comparative independent evidence falsifies expected simplicity or conformance
next: C2 parallel WS-A and WS-B on M3-H selected research architecture, no further broad architecture comparison before C4.
